description: Viral TikTok video dated 11 May 2026 claimed VP Gibran had sent a resignation letter to DPR RI. The footage was recycled from 16 Jul 2024, when he resigned as Mayor of Solo before his VP inauguration. No market window is computed for this marker because no single verified publication date anchors it.
source_note: Jabar Saber Hoaks clarification (saberhoaks.jabarprov.go.id); Jatengprov hoax clarification

description: Kompas.com fact check published 30 Sep 2026 debunked a viral video claim that Gibran had submitted a resignation letter as Vice President. A chain message in the same wave claimed he would resign on 9 Oct 2026. Treated as an observable attention marker only.
source_note: Kompas.com Cek Fakta, 30 Sep 2026; Klinik Hoaks Jatimprov

description: Mahkamah Agung cassation decision No. 742 K/TUN/2026 annulled the education equivalency letter (surat keterangan penyetaraan pendidikan) used in Gibran's 2024 candidacy.
source_note: Reported by Katadata and other national outlets; cited in Avenir research summary, 13 Nov 2026

event: Hak Menyatakan Pendapat proposal and letter revocation
description: 120 DPR members from 8 factions proposed Hak Menyatakan Pendapat (the impeachment track) related to the equivalency letter case. The Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education revoked the equivalency letter the same day, implementing the MA decision.
source_note: Reported by Kompas and other national outlets, 11-12 Nov 2026

description: Gibran Rakabuming Raka submitted his resignation letter as Vice President to the MPR (received by MPR Chair Ahmad Muzani, who confirmed it publicly) and to President Prabowo Subianto. CONFOUNDER: MSCI announced its index review results the same day (BRPT and BRMS removed from the Global Standard Index, effective 1 Dec 2026), so market moves that day cannot be attributed to a single cause.
source_note: KompasTV and CNBC Indonesia reporting, 12 Nov 2026; Bareksa Insight, 13 Nov 2026 (MSCI)

description: MPR leadership held a joint meeting to prepare filling the Vice Presidential vacancy. Under Article 8(2) of the 1945 Constitution the MPR must elect a replacement within 60 days from two candidates proposed by the President.
source_note: Antara reporting, cited in Avenir research summary, 13 Nov 2026
